svg.title: Painting in Three Panels
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Individual support sizes use the museum’s panel dimensions; left/middle spacing and curve geometry approximate the photographed installation. Overall bounds use the museum’s stated display size. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, yellow, black, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/painting-in-three-panels; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
